user.title: User profile
user.description: Basic profile used for the metabolic equations. Leave weight empty if you will connect a smart scale in the next step.

data_description.body_fat_percentage: Enable this if you have a smart scale that reports body composition — it unlocks the Cunningham equation.

smart_scale.title: Smart scale
smart_scale.description: Connect your smart scale to automatically update weight and body composition. Supports Withings, Xiaomi, Garmin, Fitbit, Renpho, Eufy, and any scale that exposes sensors in Home Assistant.

data_description.scale_stale_threshold_days: Alert if the scale has not reported in this many days.

metabolic.title: Metabolic settings
metabolic.description: Mifflin-St Jeor is recommended for most people. Cunningham requires body fat data (manual or from a connected smart scale).

data_description.protein_multiplier: Grams of protein per kg of body weight.

exercise.title: Exercise sources
exercise.description: Consumer fitness devices may overestimate calorie burn by 15-30%. Set the correction factor to 0.80-0.85 for a conservative estimate, or leave at 1.00 to use reported values as-is.

data_description.tef_percentage: TEF is already included in the baseline activity multiplier; this value is stored for reference and displayed as a TDEE attribute.

error.weight_entity_required: A weight entity is required when the smart scale is enabled.
error.weight_required: Enter a weight in the profile step or enable the smart scale.
error.cunningham_requires_body_fat: The Cunningham equation requires a body fat percentage or a mapped body fat entity.
error.peloton_calories_required: A Peloton calories entity is required when Peloton is enabled.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single Calorie Tracker instance is supported.

options.sedentary: Sedentary — desk job, minimal daily movement
options.lightly_active: Lightly active — some walking, light daily tasks
options.moderately_active: Moderately active — on feet regularly, active job
